name: Ahmedabad City Center
description: The central urban hub of Ahmedabad, serving as a primary point of navigation and commercial activity.

name: Alfa One/Nexus Mall
description: A popular shopping and entertainment destination featuring premium brands and a vibrant food court.

name: Kankaria Lake
description: A historic circular lake featuring a walkway, balloon safari, zoo, and evening light shows.

name: Atal Bridge
description: An iconic, pedestrian-only suspension bridge over the Sabarmati River with a unique design.

name: Manek Chwok Food Market
description: A bustling city square that transforms into a famous late-night street food market.

name: Thol Bird Sanctuary
description: A serene freshwater lake surrounded by marshes, home to thousands of migratory birds.

name: Thol Garden
description: A peaceful green space located near the sanctuary, ideal for nature walks and relaxation.

name: Palladium Mall
description: An upscale luxury shopping mall offering high-end international brands and fine dining options.

name: Biodiversity Riverfront Park - Sabarmati
description: An eco-friendly urban park dedicated to preserving local flora and fauna along the riverfront.

name: Narendra Modi Stadium
description: The world's largest cricket stadium, located in Motera, with a seating capacity of 132,000.

name: Adalaj Ni Vav
description: A spectacular five-story deep stepwell built in 1498, renowned for its intricate Solanki style architecture and historical stone carvings.

name: Sabarmati Ashram
description: The tranquil residence of Mahatma Gandhi along the Sabarmati River, serving as a poignant museum dedicated to India's freedom struggle.

name: Sidi Saiyyed Masjid
description: A 16th-century mosque globally celebrated for its exquisite, intricately carved stone lattice windows, notably the 'Tree of Life' motif.

name: Sabarmati Riverfront
description: A vibrant, 11 km urban riverfront promenade featuring beautifully landscaped parks, walking paths, boating, and recreational spaces.

name: Hutheesing Jain Temple
description: A stunning white marble temple known for its intricate carvings and the 78-foot-high Manastambha.

name: Nal Sarovar Bird Sanctuary
description: A paradise for birdwatchers about 60km away, this sanctuary hosts over 210 species of migratory birds, including flamingos and pelicans.

name: Nal Sarovar Bird Sanctuary - RAMSAR Wetland
description: An officially designated wetland of international importance protecting the unique aquatic habitat and nesting grounds within Nal Sarovar.

name: National Maritime Heritage Complex (NMHC)
description: A major upcoming historical and cultural destination in Lothal showcasing India's rich seafaring heritage and ancient maritime wonders.

name: Sri Siddhivinayak Devasthan | Mahemdavad
description: A unique, massive elephant-shaped Ganesha temple located near the Vatrak River that draws thousands of devotees.

name: Nagina Wadi - Kankaria Lake
description: An island at the lake's center hosting a themed garden and a popular musical fountain show in the evenings.

name: Science City Ahmedabad
description: An expansive educational and entertainment center featuring an IMAX 3D theater, a robotics gallery, an aquatic gallery, and interactive spaces.

name: The Calico Museum of Textiles
description: The Calico Museum of Textiles is one of the world's most comprehensive collections of historical Indian fabrics. Exhibits: Displays five centuries of textiles, including Mughal brocades, rare Patola silks, and intricate pichhwais. Planning: Tours are strictly guided and require advance online registration due to limited daily seating.

name: Dastan Autoworld - Vintage car Museum
description: Auto World Vintage Car Museum showcases over 120 pristine classic vehicles, forming one of India's largest collections of vintage cars and carriages.

name: Lothal - Archeological Remains of A Harappa Port
description: Lothal is a world-renowned site of the Indus Valley Civilization

name: Shree Bhimnath Mahadev Temple
description: The ancient Bhimnath Mahadev Temple is a highly revered site located just a few kilometers outside Dhandhuka.

name: Amdavad ni Gufa
description: An underground, cave-like art gallery designed by architect B.V. Doshi, featuring vibrant, custom wall art painted by the legendary artist M.F. Husain.

name: Jama Masjid
description: A grand, yellow-sandstone Friday mosque built in 1424 by Sultan Ahmed Shah, showcasing classic Indo-Islamic architecture and vast courtyards.

name: Law Garden Fashion Street
description: A lively evening street market packed with colorful stalls selling traditional Gujarati attire, handcrafted embroidered textiles, and local street snacks.

name: Gujarat Tourism Law Garden
description: An iconic urban park celebrated for its lively evening market packed with traditional Gujarati handicrafts, ethnic clothing, and local street food.

name: ISKCON Temple Ahmedabad
description: A magnificent marble temple dedicated to Radha and Krishna, featuring daily devotional singing, elaborate architectural patterns, and a peaceful ambiance.

name: Dada Hari Vav - Bai Harir Sultani Vav
description: An incredible five-story deep subterranean stepwell built in 1485, famous for its beautifully preserved Indo-Islamic stone carvings.

name: Amrutvarshini Vav (Stepwell) Paanchkuva
description: An 18th-century, 50-foot-deep stepwell famous for its rare L-shaped architectural layout.

name: Jhulta Minar - Sidi Bashir Mosque
description: The Sidi Bashir Mosque is a former Sufi mosque. Only the central gateway and two minarets survive; they are known as the Jhulta Minar or Shaking Minarets. The structure is a Monument of National Importance.

name: Sarkhej Roza
description: The Sarkhej Roza is a Sufi mosque and tomb complex located in the village of Makarba. Although there are many rozas across Gujarat, the Sarkhej Roza is the most revered.

name: Shree Manibhadra Veer Jain Tirth, Udhroj
description: A peaceful Jain pilgrimage site located in Udharoj, famous for its excavated full-figure idol of Lord Manibhadra Veer seated on an elephant.

name: Parimal Garden
description: Parimal Garden, officially known as Pari Trikamlal Bhogilal Municipal Recreation Park, is an urban park in the Ambawadi area of Ahmedabad. It covers an area of 8.5 acres (34,000 m2). It was built in 1960, and redeveloped in 1998 and 2021. The park has a pond, a walkway, an amphitheatre, a gym, and sports facilities.

name: Lokmanya Tilak Garden
description: Lokmanya Tilak Garden, formerly known as Victoria Garden, is a is an urban park in Ahmedabad. It was proposed in 1897 to commemorate Queen Victoria's diamond jubilee and was opened in 1905. It has few monuments including ones dedicated to Lokmanya Tilak and Mahagujarat movement. It was renovated and refurbished in 2021. It has walkways, central lawn, bandstand, forest walk, maze garden, children's play area and civic amenities.

name: Shri Jagannathji Mandir
description: The Jagannath Temple is a temple dedicated to the Hindu God Jagannath in the city of Ahmedabad in the Gujarat state of India. The temple is famous for its annual chariot festival, the Rath Yatra, which is the third most important and largest after the Ratha Yatra at Puri.

name: Butterfly Park - Kankaria Lake
description: An eco-educational park on the lakefront featuring landscaped gardens specifically cultivated to breed and house diverse local butterfly species.

name: Kamla Nehru Zoological Garden - Kankaria Lake
description: A sprawling lakeside zoo founded in 1951, home to diverse wildlife, a reptile house, and notable conservation programs.

name: Balvatika Fun Carnival Theme Park - Kankaria Lake
description: A popular, family-friendly lakeside children's park featuring amusement rides, an optical illusion mirror house, and a planetarium.

name: EKA Arena
description: EKA Arena (formerly The Arena by TransStadia) is a multi-purpose stadium located near Kankaria Lake. The stadium was officially opened on 7 October 2016. It was built in a public-private partnership between the Government of Gujarat and SE TransStadia, a company led by entrepreneur Udit Sheth. The stadium seats 20,000 spectators in its main football configuration. It is capable of being partitioned into an indoor arena, allowing it to host other sporting events (such as kabaddi and table tennis).

name: Jaldhara Water World
description: A lively family-friendly water park right on the Kankaria Lakefront, featuring water slides, wave pools, rain dancing, and an indoor arcade.

name: Amrapali Funland
description: A premier theme park on the Kankaria Lakefront featuring the high-speed Boomerang Roller Coaster, thrill rides, and an integrated family water park zone.

name: Lal Bahadur Shashtri Garden
description: A lively municipal neighborhood park in eastern Ahmedabad featuring walking tracks, shaded green lawns, and outdoor play areas for children.

name: Sardar Patel Stadium - Navrangpura
description: An iconic 1960s architectural landmark designed by Charles Correa, historically famous for hosting India's first ODI match and currently utilized as a public jogging and fitness hub.

name: Glow Garden
description: An enchanting evening park inside the Flower Park featuring a 'Moon Trail' of glowing tunnels, interactive LED installations, and illuminated wildlife sculptures.

name: Flower Park - Sabarmati Riverfront
description: A vibrant 45,000-square-meter botanical park on the west bank housing over 330 plant species, unique green topiaries, and the annual city flower festival.

name: Veechar Utensils Museum
description: A world-renowned museum located at Vishalla, showcasing a unique, historic collection of over 4,500 traditional Indian kitchen utensils.
